description: This file defines classes and methods for managing bank statements, statement lines, and reconciliation in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including default values, balance calculations, confirmation, cancellation, and onchange behaviors.

classes.name: account_bank_statement
classes.description: Model for managing bank statements, including default values, balance calculations, confirmation, cancellation, and onchange behaviors.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile
classes.description: Model for handling reconciliation of bank statement lines.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile_line
classes.description: Model for individual reconciliation lines within a statement reconciliation.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_line
classes.description: Model for individual bank statement lines, including onchange logic for partner and amount, and reconciliation amount calculation.

methods.name: _default_journal_id
methods.description: Returns default journal ID from context if available.

methods.name: _default_balance_start
methods.description: Fetches the latest ending balance for the journal to set as starting balance.

methods.name: _end_balance
methods.description: Calculates the ending balance of a statement based on move lines and statement lines.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Finds the current accounting period.

methods.name: _currency
methods.description: Determines the currency for the statement, defaulting to journal or company currency.

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the bank statement, creating accounting moves and reconciling lines.

methods.name: button_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a confirmed statement, deleting associated moves.

methods.name: onchange_journal_id
methods.description: Updates starting balance and currency when journal is changed.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes draft statements; prevents deletion of confirmed ones.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a statement with empty move lines.

methods.name: _total_entry
methods.description: Computes total debit minus credit for statement lines.

methods.name: _total_new
methods.description: Computes total amount of write-off lines.

methods.name: _total_balance
methods.description: Calculates total balance considering entries and write-offs.

methods.name: _total_amount
methods.description: Computes total amount in the statement's currency.

methods.name: _default_amount
methods.description: Provides default amount based on context.

methods.name: _total_currency
methods.description: Returns the currency ID for the statement.

methods.name: _default_currency
methods.description: Provides default currency ID from user's company.

methods.name: _total_second_amount
methods.description: Returns amount in secondary currency context.

methods.name: _total_second_currency
methods.description: Returns currency ID in secondary currency context.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Generates display name for reconciliation records.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates account and amount based on partner selection.

methods.name: _reconcile_amount
methods.description: Calculates the amount reconciled in secondary currency.
